status_definitions.supported_native: The feature maps directly to accepted VC4Kernel semantics and does not require a source-level caveat, though implementation may be staged.
status_definitions.supported_composite: The feature is expressed using a canonical composition of accepted VC4Kernel primitives, not a new first-class VC4Kernel op.
status_definitions.supported_emulated: The feature can preserve semantics through slower expansion or multi-step lowering; performance may be poor.
status_definitions.supported_with_policy_caveat: The feature lowers only when the source or compiler policy explicitly accepts finite, approximate, storage-conversion, or other non-default semantics.
status_definitions.supportable_later: Hardware/VC4Kernel support appears sufficient, but this phase intentionally does not design the full lowering yet.
status_definitions.temporary_reject_not_implemented: The feature is not accepted in the current staged implementation, but no permanent hardware/semantic impossibility has been proven.
status_definitions.deterministic_reject_value_surface_polic: The value surface refuses the feature as an initial source-boundary policy, even if a later phase may support it.
status_definitions.deterministic_reject_vc4kernel_contract: The locked VC4Kernel surface rejects the corresponding target form.
status_definitions.permanent_reject_hardware_or_semantic_im: VC4 cannot preserve the required semantics even through slow emulation; requires a proof under compiler/docs/vc4_ttir_reject_proof_policy.md once that file exists.
status_definitions.out_of_scope_non_compute_hardware: Fixed-function graphics/texture/tile-buffer/display features outside the VC4 compute-kernel target.
status_definitions.internal_only: Resource/manifest/runtime/audit/artifact contract, not a source-program feature.
status_definitions.frontend_specialization: The construct is resolved by Triton frontend specialization or TTIR generation before runtime value control-flow import is required.
status_definitions.phase_inventory_target: A future phase must inspect real emitted TTIR forms before support or reject classification is locked.
status_definitions.lowerable_if_matches_value_cf_subset: A TTIR control-flow form may lower only when structural analysis proves it matches the locked Phase 8 value-cf subset; otherwise it remains staged or rejects with the first unsupported boundary named.
status_definitions.lowerable_phase85: A real source-controlled parseable Phase85a2 TTIR control-flow form is a Phase 8.5 implementation target when its regions/body use otherwise supported operations.
status_definitions.static_specialized_no_runtime_cf: Real Triton emitted straight-line TTIR for the source construct, so no runtime control-flow import is required.
status_definitions.staged_by_body_feature: The control-flow skeleton is classified separately from an unsupported body operation; diagnostics name the exact body feature.
status_definitions.deterministic_reject_target_profile: The VC4 target profile rejects the construct at the source/value boundary, such as vector or per-lane branch CFG.
status_definitions.deterministic_reject_source_boundary: The construct is outside the accepted VC4 TTIR source boundary, such as backend dialect control flow.
status_definitions.not_emitted_by_real_triton: The form was sought but not emitted by the pinned real Triton frontend and must not be supported from guessed TTIR.
status_definitions.frontend_rejected: The pinned real Triton frontend rejected the source form before TTIR emission.
status_definitions.inventory_only: The row records classification evidence or provenance without being an implementation target.

phase_targets.phase3: First narrow handwritten value lowering slices.
phase_targets.phase4: Core vector, mask, elementwise, simple memory, and control expansion.
phase_targets.phase5: Reductions, math policy, f16 storage, subword, and shuffle policy expansion.
phase_targets.phase6: Tiling, VPM/VDR/VDW planning, contracts, and GEMV/GEMM-oriented planning.
phase_targets.phase6_inventory_only: Inventory or profile-only row that must not be implemented in Phase 6.
phase_targets.phase7: Real TTIR ingestion and target-profile hookup after handwritten value paths are proven.
phase_targets.future_hardware_proof: Requires a future hardware-proven phase before a locked target reject can change.
phase_targets.phase8_5: TTIR control-flow bridge/support/reject lock after Phase 8 value control flow.
phase_targets.phase9_5: TTIR mask/memory-legality bridge/support/reject lock after Phase 9 value mask classifier.
phase_targets.phase10_5: TTIR gather/strided memory bridge after Phase 10 value memory expansion.

notes: This taxonomy is a Phase 1 specification artifact and does not implement any compiler feature.
READY_FOR_TRITON remains NO until the handwritten value path is proven.
Permanent rejects require proof under compiler/docs/vc4_ttir_reject_proof_policy.md once that file exists.
Locked VC4Kernel rejects do not automatically prove source-level permanent impossibility; emulation may remain supportable later.
Vertical value/TTIR increments require a TTIR bridge/support/reject lock after each coherent source-visible value capability unless the value phase is internal-only.
Phase85b locks real TTIR control-flow classifications from source-controlled snapshots; READY_FOR_TRITON remains NO.
